question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

AVXE, DSUH, GPRK, ?, MJLQ
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First and fourth letter → (3) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second and third letter → (3) is subtracted from the position values according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1937e7dccd2c91d528f8b6c5eff1f7a5578591ac4fd771fec7b9e8805723bd21.png] 

​Hence, "**JMON**" is the correct answer.
